article.headline: Amgen Holds Near 52-Week High As Biotech ETFs Add Shares
article.deck: Amgen sits at the top of its 447.13-469.49 buy range from an eight-week cup, 4.9% past the buy point, with no premarket print yet.
body: Amgen slipped 4.70, or 1.0%, to 469.24 in Wednesday's session, the last before the holiday, trading 1.17x its 50-day average volume. The stock broke out of an eight-week cup on 2026-10-22, trading 1.11x average that day. The cup ran 16.2% deep from its 2026-08-25 high to a 2026-09-16 low. The buy point is 447.13 and the buy range runs to 469.49, so the close sits 4.9% above the buy point and 25 cents inside the top of the range.

The stock is 3.0% below its 52-week high of 483.99, 24 sessions after the breakout. It closed 7.7% above its 50-day line at 435.62 and 22.0% above its 200-day line. The 21-day exponential average is at 454.56, and the stock sits 0.74 ATRs from the 21-day line, an intact trend that is not stretched. Amgen ranks 88 of 99 on the desk's list, and its RS line is 0.7% from its high. Shares are up 43.4% this year and 40.4% over twelve months.

In the September quarter, earnings rose 19.4% to 7.08 a share and revenue rose 8.5% to $10.37 billion. EPS ran 2.45, 3.34 and 4.37 in the three quarters before. The market values Amgen at $253.8 billion and 18.7 times forward earnings. The next report is due 2027-02-02.
GuruFocus reported that the iShares Biotechnology ETF added Gilead and Amgen on Nov. 25, and that 45 ETFs added to Amgen holdings that day.
A close back under the 447.13 buy point would turn this into a stalled breakout; a close above 469.49 puts the stock past the range.
article.watch: Whether Amgen holds inside the range on Friday or closes above 469.49, which ends the buy range.

article.headline: Walmart Sits 2.4% Off Its High Heading Into Black Friday
article.deck: The 26-week cup's buy point is 135.26 with a buy range to 142.02, and the early entries at 129.95 and 131.42 are already cleared.
body: Walmart heads into Black Friday after easing 37 cents, or 0.3%, to 131.94 on Wednesday, trading 1.04x its 50-day average volume. The stock is building the right side of a 26-week cup that ran 24.4% deep from its 2026-05-19 high to a 2026-08-21 low. The buy point is 135.26 and the buy range runs to 142.02; the close sits 2.5% below the buy point.

Two early entries are live. The stock has cleared the handle high of 129.95 from 2026-11-16 and closed 1.5% above it, and it closed above the downtrend line from the May high through the 2026-11-05 high, which crosses at 131.42. The 52-week high is 135.16, 2.4% overhead. Walmart trades 11.8% above its 50-day line at 118.03 and 10.8% above its 200-day line, and 1.72 ATRs from the 21-day line at 126.20, a firm trend short of stretched. It ranks 92 of 99 on the desk's list, with its RS line 6.2% off its high. Shares are up 28.6% in three months and 18.4% this year.

The fundamentals are the weak part. October-quarter EPS fell 19.5% to 62 cents. Revenue in the July quarter rose 5.9% to $187.94 billion. The company is worth $1.05 trillion at 40.9 times forward earnings. The next report is due 2027-02-18.

A TIKR headline said Walmart already lets Meta's Muse AI agent shop, while Amazon is in talks to do the same. Reuters framed Black Friday as a test for retailers as tight budgets meet AI-savvy shoppers.
article.watch: A close above 135.26, which also clears the 135.16 52-week high.

article.headline: Starbucks Picks Banks For Japan Sale, Report Says; Stock Near High
article.deck: Starbucks sits 2.6% below the 110.61 buy point of a 15-week cup, with an early entry above 108.69 after a bounce off the 21-day line.
body: Starbucks rose 1.36, or 1.3%, to 107.74 on Wednesday, trading 1.06x its 50-day average volume. Verdict Food Service reported Thursday that the company has selected banks to sell its Japanese business. The stock is in a 15-week cup that ran 21.0% deep from its 2026-08-13 high to a 2026-10-08 low. The buy point is 110.61 and the buy range runs to 116.14; the close is 2.6% below the buy point.

Wednesday's session pulled back to the 21-day line at 105.60 and closed above it, reading 0.0 ATRs from the 21-day line. That sets an early entry above the day's high of 108.69, 0.9% over the close. The 52-week high is 111.50, 3.4% away. The stock closed 7.2% above its 50-day line at 100.47 and 6.8% above its 200-day line. It ranks 76 of 99 on the desk's list, and its RS line sits 0.1% from its high. Shares are up 27.9% this year.

September-quarter EPS jumped 391.7% to 59 cents, but revenue fell 4.5% to $9.14 billion. Revenue has slipped in each of the four quarters given, from $9.92 billion to $9.53 billion, $9.32 billion and now $9.14 billion. EPS ran 26 cents, 45 cents and 91 cents in the three quarters before. Starbucks is valued at $122.8 billion and 28.9 times forward earnings. The next report is due 2027-01-27.
A close back under the 21-day line would cancel the early entry and leave the stock setting up below 110.61.
article.watch: A move above 108.69 for the early entry, then 110.61 for the cup's buy point.
